# unifi_protect_camera (Resource)

A UniFi Protect camera (doorbells are cameras), identified by MAC. Configures the existing, adopted camera over the private Protect API (`/proxy/protect/api/cameras/<id>`): name, microphone, status LED, on-screen-display overlays, HDR/video mode, smart-detection types, recording mode, and the doorbell LCD message. Read-only telemetry (state, model, adoption) is exposed as computed. `terraform destroy` removes the camera from state and leaves it configured as last-applied; set `forget_on_destroy = true` to unadopt it. **Config writes and unadopt are HIL-unverified — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac` (String) Camera MAC address (the natural key); any separator/case is accepted and normalized to lowercase colon-separated form. The camera must be adopted and visible to Protect. Immutable — changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `forget_on_destroy` (Boolean) When `true`, `terraform destroy` unadopts (forgets) the camera instead of just removing it from state. Defaults to `false`. Guard expensive cameras with `prevent_destroy`.
- `hdr_type` (String) High Dynamic Range mode (e.g. `auto`, `off`); supported values vary by model.
- `lcd_message_text` (String) Doorbell LCD message text (for `CUSTOM_MESSAGE`).
- `lcd_message_type` (String) Doorbell LCD message type: `LEAVE_PACKAGE_AT_DOOR`, `DO_NOT_DISTURB`, `CUSTOM_MESSAGE`, or `IMAGE`. Only valid on doorbell cameras.
- `mic_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the camera microphone is enabled.
- `mic_volume` (Number) Microphone volume (0–100).
- `name` (String) Camera display name.
- `osd_date_enabled` (Boolean) Show the date in the on-screen display.
- `osd_debug_enabled` (Boolean) Show debug info in the on-screen display.
- `osd_logo_enabled` (Boolean) Show the logo in the on-screen display.
- `osd_name_enabled` (Boolean) Show the camera name in the on-screen display.
- `recording_mode` (String) Recording mode: `always`, `schedule`, `never`, `detections`, or `adaptive`.
- `smart_detect_audio_types` (Set of String) Smart-detection audio types to detect (e.g. `smoke_cmonx`, `alrmSmoke`). Model-dependent.
- `smart_detect_object_types` (Set of String) Smart-detection object types to detect (e.g. `person`, `vehicle`, `animal`, `package`). Model-dependent.
- `status_light_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the status LED is enabled.
- `video_mode` (String) Video mode: `default`, `highFps`, `homekit`, `sport`, `slowShutter`, `lprReflex`, or `lprNoneReflex`.

### Read-Only

- `has_speaker` (Boolean) Whether the camera has a speaker.
- `host` (String) Current management IP/host.
- `id` (String) Protect object id (24-hex). Import key.
- `is_adopted` (Boolean) Whether the camera is adopted by this console.
- `model` (String) Hardware model (e.g. `UVC G4 Doorbell`).
- `state` (String) Connection state (`CONNECTED`, `DISCONNECTED`, …).
- `type` (String) Device type identifier.
